name: Dömös (Hungary)
description: Nine equal horizontal stripes alternating red and white, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Dömös: a crowned green shield with the Hungarian arms, below a carved stone capital and a red scroll inscribed DÖMÖS.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Dömös arms with crown, capital and scroll
